note: installServiceMacOS: 'if uninstall { unload+remove plist; return }' vs falling through to install - textbook dual-purpose CLI-command flag.
GeneratePRPrompt: 'if includeDescription && pr.Body != ""' gates whether the PR description section is appended to the generated prompt.
setupReportPRCreatedReassignmentFixture: 'if seedFeedbackAddressedAt' conditionally seeds PrFeedbackAddressedAt on the fixture, per the doc comment's AC7 note - genuine test-fixture flag argument.

NewPRVerification: 'if matched && !exists { ... matched = false }' validates/corrects a cross-field invariant (Matched implies Exists), not a caller-selected behavior mode - similar in kind to the k8s addBool case (branching to validate/normalize the value itself, not to pick which code path to run for the caller).

insertEscapeEventAt: 'if mangled { mangleType = "truncated" }' derives mangleType from mangled. Note: the sibling insertEscapeEvent (line 40) only forwards mangled to this function and is correctly NOT flagged - confirms the pass-through exemption works on real code.
notifyTriagePersistFailure: 'if !statusAdvanced { body += ... }' appends extra guidance text only when the item's status transition itself did not go through.

spawnSessionAfterGates: isReopen is branched on repeatedly in the body (building the revision title, an isReopen-only step, and a final '!isReopen' guard skipping the in_progress transition since dequeue already CAS'd it) - the doc comment explains the reopen-vs-fresh-spawn distinction driving each branch.
MaybeTriggerTriage: skipTriage is an operand of 'if skipTriage || repoPath == "" || s.headlessPool == nil { return false }' - one of three independent early-out gates before triggering triage.

setupLockedWithNative: 'if native { return g.nativeSetupNewWorktreeWithSelfHeal() }' - dispatches between native vs non-native worktree setup; the doc comment above even explains why the flag is resolved once and passed through rather than re-read.

failStage: asError picks Error vs Warn log level for the stage-failure line (if asError {Error} else {Warn}) - the doc comment even explains why the flag exists (persist stage needs Error since LLM cost is already spent).
recoverConversationBeforeLaunch: 'if firstTimeSetup || ... { return }' is an early-return guard skipping conversation-UUID recovery for non-fresh instances.
reviveOutcomeForColdRestore: everHadHistory is the second-level 'if everHadHistory' branch (after hasClaudeSession) deriving which ReviveOutcome to report.
setAutonomousCompleteLocked: 'if done { AutonomousOutcome = "done" } else { ... = "stuck" }' maps the bool directly to one of two outcome strings.
